page: Google Cloud Platform c2d-highcpu-8 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. It is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The processor includes 32 MB of L3 cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 KB of L1d cache. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core performance ranking in the top 25% at 2931.08. Multi-core performance and general compute metrics, such as the Geekbench multi-core score of 6523.0 and Passmark CPU score of 12865.49, fall within the average tier. Memory bandwidth is measured at 68.67 GB/sec for large block reads and 49.73 GB/sec for large block writes. Multi-threaded decompression represents a relative bottleneck, with bzip3 multi-threaded performance scoring in the bottom 25% at 36.88 GB/sec.

The c2d-highcpu-8 instance offers a cost-effective profile for compute-bound workloads that do not demand large memory capacities. By maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, it avoids the overhead of unutilized memory resources. This configuration is suitable for workloads such as software compilation, static web serving, and light language model inference, as demonstrated by a static web serving throughput of 10.6 GB/sec and a 135M model text generation speed of 240.3 tokens/sec.

With 4 physical cores and 2 threads per core, it provides a lean 2.0 GB of memory per vCPU. The instance lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Benchmark data highlights strong single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core tests, while multi-core compute, memory bandwidth, and web serving throughput sit in the average tier. Conversely, multi-threaded decompression is a relative weakness, scoring in the bottom 25%. This resource profile makes the c2d-highcpu-8 highly cost-efficient for CPU-heavy tasks that do not require large memory footprints, such as software compilation, static web serving, and moderate computational workloads.
